sources.title: OpenAI: Introducing Astra for Law (Sep 17)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: OpenAI Sep 17 introduces Astra for Law: GPT-6 Astra configured with legal settings, tools, and context for professional legal work; API customers Harvey and Legora to build on it; model picker GPT-6 Astra Law; API gpt-6-astra-law; Trusted Access in ChatGPT and Codex first, API coming soon.
claims.context: Announcement lede; GPT-6 Astra as base model stated.

claims.text: Legal search index covers U.S. case law, statutes, regulations, court rules, administrative decisions across 230M+ URLs with daily additions; Free Law Project/CourtListener case-law collection (>99.9% published U.S. precedential) incorporated.
claims.context: Legal research section as stated; CourtListener coverage via Free Law Project stated.

claims.text: Vals AI Legal Research Bench private validation (200 questions): Astra for Law 54.0% overall correctness vs 38.7% GPT-6 Astra + web search at highest reasoning effort (40% relative); +24% reference cases on case-law questions; up to +54% relevant passages at same effort.
claims.context: Benchmark section as stated; private validation set, vendor-reported, unreproduced.

claims.text: Trusted Access Program for eligible firms with Zero Data Retention on API and ChatGPT Enterprise excluded from human review by default; governance design with Latham & Watkins (permissions, ethical walls, client instructions, oversight).
claims.context: Trust section as stated; Latham collaboration stated.

claims.text: 26 partner-built plugins (Relativity, Clio, iManage, Intapp, DeepJudge, Thomson Reuters HighQ/CoCounsel preview) plus 9 community plugins (LegalQuants, LECG, Skills.law) with 47 custom skills; ChatGPT for Word GA; firm builds (S&C agreement analyzer, Ropes & Gray diligence, Cooley GO Public, Skadden regulatory suite) and Wachtell exploration as first-party testimonials.
claims.context: Ecosystem section as stated; counts vendor-stated.
